question: Which year was the first World Happiness Report published?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2012**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **first World Happiness Report** was published in **2012** by the United Nations.
 
• This report was launched during the **United Nations High-Level Meeting on Happiness and Well-Being**, which aimed to bring global attention to the importance of happiness as a measure of social progress.
 
• The report ranks countries based on their happiness levels, measured by factors such as GDP per capita, social support, life expectancy, freedom, generosity, and corruption.
 
• It is produced by the **Sustainable Development Solutions Network (SDSN)** in collaboration with leading global experts in economics, psychology, and survey analysis.
 
• Since 2012, the report has been released annually, providing insights into factors influencing happiness and well-being globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Happiness Report**

 
 
• The report is based on data collected through the **Gallup World Poll**, which surveys residents in more than 150 countries.
 
• It uses a scale of 0 to 10, where respondents evaluate their current lives relative to the best and worst possible lives they imagine.
 
• The report's findings are used to shape public policies that prioritize citizens' well-being over purely economic measures of success.
 
 
 
• **Happiness Indicators**
 
 
• Key indicators used in the report include **economic production, social support, life expectancy, freedom to make life choices, generosity, and perceptions of corruption.**
 
• Each of these factors contributes to the overall happiness score of a country.
 
 
 
• **Happiest Countries**
 
 
• Countries like Finland, Denmark, and Switzerland frequently rank among the top nations in the report due to their strong social systems, trust in public institutions, and high quality of life.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Report**
 
 
• The World Happiness Report emphasizes the importance of well-being and mental health in the global development agenda.
 
• It encourages governments to adopt policies that foster equitable economic growth and social cohesion.
